source.title: Definitive Australia Guide 2022
source.extractionMethod: All 103 slides rendered and visually reviewed; concise candidate units combine repeated concepts while state distinctions and source anchors are retained.

limitations: Inventory is an editorial candidate graph, not an assertion of a complete country syllabus or an optimal learning sequence.
No new panorama coordinates, labels or live practice pools are fabricated. A source claim is not active/drillable until locations and comparison examples are verified.
Existing IDs indicate overlap with a currently tagged LM drill; they do not imply every source subfeature has tagged locations.
2022 camera, roads, public transit, regulatory and brand examples require contemporary corroboration.
One source image per regional scene is not sufficient for mastery or unseen-transfer testing.
Species names and unnamed vehicle locations have not been inferred from photos.

neverUse: deck teaching anchors as unseen transfer evidence
source coverage count as a mastery percentage
